episodes.name: Shock Waves
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigates a well-orchestrated bombing at the funeral of Officer Franklin Clark

episodes.name: Pool Shark
episodes.overview: The team investigates when a woman is attacked by a shark in the pool at a Las Vegas casino.

episodes.name: Blood Moon
episodes.overview: A vampire and werewolf convention becomes the center of a murder investigation.

episodes.name: Sqweegel
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigates a mad slasher who strikes without leaving a trace -- because he wears a form-fitting black latex suit that leaves not a molecule of evidence behind

episodes.name: House of Hoarders
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigate a murder at the home of Marta, a "level 5 hoarder" whose home is stacked high with possessions and garbage--and more than one dead body

episodes.name: Cold Blooded
episodes.overview: The CSI team investigate the murder of a man whose daughter was killed five years ago, and the bizarre death of a young man who appears to have been killed by a T-Rex.

episodes.name: Bump and Grind
episodes.overview: When shredded remains of a man are discovered, evidence leads to multiple possible suspects.

episodes.name: Fracked
episodes.overview: The CSI's investigate a series of deaths related to an energy company's grotesque cover-up of tainted water.

episodes.name: Wild Life
episodes.overview: The sky is falling or at least people are. The CSI's try to figure out if it was murder or sucide after a man is dead after falling from a hotel. Across town, a elderly woman falls through her table and her husband dead in the shower. The only two witnesses to the crime are an incooperative cat and a parrot who pleads the fifth.
The CSIs set out to track down a pedophile suspected of murdering an FBI agent's wife and kidnapping his children.

episodes.name: Man Up
episodes.overview: The CSIs question the validity of an online picture depicting a murdered call girl until they find the same woman strangled to death in the dumpster that appears in the photo.

episodes.name: A Kiss Before Frying
episodes.overview: A body with unusual burn marks is discovered on the side of the road; Greg asks a teacher (Dita von Teese) out on a date.

episodes.name: The Two Mrs. Grissoms
episodes.overview: Sara clashes with her mother-in-law and a woman from Gil's past.

episodes.name: All That Cremains
episodes.overview: The Crime Scene crew investigates the gruesome murder of a high-powered, widowed lawyer, while Ray faces that it is time to move on from his old life.

episodes.name: Targets of Obsession
episodes.overview: Jason McCann contacts Nick and says that he's in imminent danger. Langston has a courtroom war of nerves against serial killer Nate Haskell. A bomb tech disarms a bomb attached to Nick's house. But when he accompanies Nick, Catherine and Vartann to a warehouse with multiple booby-traps per square inch, Kip has to really earn his paycheck to find a safe way out for the CSI team.

episodes.name: Turn On, Tune In, Drop Dead
episodes.overview: The team investigates two apparent corpses who aren't exactly dead at all.

episodes.name: The List
episodes.overview: While investigating the murder of a convicted ex-cop, the CSIs stumble upon a list in his prison cell with names of several individuals he believed might have been his wife's true killer.

episodes.name: Hitting for the Cycle
episodes.overview: A string of deaths, including a gamer found dead on his couch and a newly divorced man at the bottom of a pool, instigate a bet among the CSIs as to whether they've "hit for the cycle" - a homicide, a suicide, an accidental and a natural death all in one night

episodes.name: Unleashed
episodes.overview: Langston and Sara turn to Lady Heather for help in tracking down the culprit responsible for injuring a woman before she was seemingly mauled to death by a mountain lion. Meanwhile, Nick and Dr. Robbins manage to rescue the unborn baby of a teenage girl who appears to have committed suicide.

episodes.name: Father of the Bride (1)
episodes.overview: Following his escape, Nate Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, resurfaces when he e-mails a disturbing video to the father of one of his brides, threatening to take her life.

episodes.name: Cello and Goodbye (2)
episodes.overview: Langston becomes more determined than ever to track down Nate Haskell, the notorious "Dick & Jane" killer, after discovering that he's kidnapped his ex-wife, Gloria.

episodes.name: In A Dark, Dark House (3)
episodes.overview: After years of pursuit and a countless number of murders, Langston comes face-to-face with serial killer Nate Haskell inside the house where his killing spree began.
